dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast white horizontal band visible across the greater coverts with moderate thickness.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, prominent pale blue-grey edges create distinct linear boundaries along the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, irregular rectangular pale patch visible on the central posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct non-linear boundary separating the dark crown and white nape patch from the greenish-grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Large, high-contrast white auricular/cheek patch visible on the lateral side of the head.
